title: Indonesia Becomes 1st SE Asian Nation to Ban Social Media for Minors Under 16
summary: Indonesia mandates age verification and account deactivation for children under 16 across YouTube, TikTok, Meta, X, and Roblox.

blocks.text: 🪝 Indonesia Becomes 1st SE Asian Nation to Ban Social Media for Minors Under 16. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Indonesia enacted a nationwide ban on social media use for children under 16 to protect 70 million minors from cyberbullying, addiction, and scams, following Australia's Dec 2025 law.
